High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 21
Case :- Writ - C No. - 17005 of 2022
Petitioner :- Aftab
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Mohammad Arshad Khan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents.
The instant writ petition has been filed praying for a mandamus commanding the respondents to grant licence to the petitioner under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
According to the petitioner, the matter is pending before respondent no.4 for grant of 'no objection certificate'
Learned Standing Counsel fairly states that the application of the petitioner will be decided within such time, as may be directed by this Court.

Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of with the direction to the competent authority to decide the application of the petitioner for licence under the provisions of Food Safety & Standards Act,
Aftab vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 14 June, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81360398/
1 2006 within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of true attested copy of the instant order after obtaining reports from the concerned departments.
